cues.caption: Welcome back, champ!
cues.text: Hey champ! Welcome back. Today is a very special day.

cues.caption: Last time: AI helps, people stay in charge
cues.text: Last time, we saw AI helping doctors, scientists, and artists. And we learned that AI is a tool. People stay in charge.

cues.caption: Chapter 5 · Capstone: Imagine Your Own AI Helper
cues.text: Today is chapter five, the final chapter of the whole AI track. It's your capstone. Imagine your own AI helper!

cues.caption: Capstone = your big, final project
cues.text: Capstone. Remember? It's the very last stone, right on top. So this is your big, final project!

cues.caption: You're the AI designer! No coding needed
cues.text: Today, you are the AI designer. No coding needed. Just a clear idea, a pencil, and your imagination.

cues.caption: Meera's balcony garden
cues.text: Remember Meera? She and her nani have a little balcony garden. A tulsi plant, a money plant, and two rose pots.

cues.caption: Oh no! The plants are drooping
cues.text: But everyone at home is so busy. Some days, nobody waters the plants. And the leaves go droopy, and brown. Oh no!

cues.caption: What AI helper could help? Think!
cues.text: What kind of AI helper could help Meera's family? Think for a moment.

cues.caption: Meera's idea: Plant Pal!
cues.text: Meera has an idea. An AI helper called, Plant Pal! Let's design it together, step by step. Then you'll imagine your own.

cues.caption: Four steps to design an AI helper
cues.text: Designing an AI helper takes four simple steps.

cues.caption: Who & job → Data → Privacy rule → Present
cues.text: Step one, who it helps, and what job it does. Step two, what data it learns from. Step three, a privacy rule, to keep people safe. And step four, present it in one minute.

cues.caption: Step 1: User = the person it helps
cues.text: Step one. Always decide this first. Who does your helper help? That person is called the user. Plant Pal's users are Meera's family.

cues.caption: One job: tell us when a plant needs water
cues.text: Then, give it one job. Something it does really well. Not ten jobs, just one! Plant Pal's job is to tell the family when a plant needs water.

cues.caption: "It helps ___ to ___."
cues.text: Try saying it like this. Plant Pal helps my family, water our plants on time. And see? A fun name makes it easy to remember!

cues.caption: Step 2: Data = the examples it learns from
cues.text: Step two. What data does it learn from? Remember, AI learns from examples. Those examples are called data. They can be pictures, sounds, or words.

cues.caption: Healthy leaves and dry leaves
cues.text: Plant Pal learns from lots and lots of leaf photos. Fresh, healthy, green leaves. And dry, droopy, brown leaves.

cues.caption: Pattern: droopy, brown leaves → needs water
cues.text: From many examples, it spots a pattern. A pattern is something that repeats. Droopy, brown leaves usually mean, I need water!

cues.caption: Many kinds of examples make it fairer
cues.text: And to be fair, it needs many kinds of examples. Big plants and small plants. Sunny days and cloudy days. Otherwise, it might only work for roses!

cues.caption: Those leaf photos are its…?
cues.text: Quick check! Plant Pal learns from many photos of dry and healthy leaves. Those photos are its, passwords? Wake words? Or examples? Think.

cues.caption: Examples! That's its data.
cues.text: Examples! The photos are its data. The examples it learns patterns from.

cues.caption: Step 3: A privacy rule
cues.text: Step three. A privacy rule. That's a promise about what your helper will never collect, or store.

cues.caption: Only collect what the job needs
cues.text: Here's the golden rule. Only collect what the job needs. Nothing extra. Plant Pal needs leaf photos. Does it need your face? Your home address? Where you are right now? No way!

cues.caption: Rule: never store photos of people
cues.text: So Plant Pal's privacy rule is, it must never store photos of people.

cues.caption: People stay in charge
cues.text: And remember, people stay in charge. Plant Pal can say, water me! But nani decides how much water to give.

cues.caption: Spelling helper: which data is NOT needed?
cues.text: Let's sort! A spelling helper helps kids practise spellings. Which data does it not need? A list of spelling words. The child's home address. Common spelling mistakes. Or which words the child got right. Think.

cues.caption: Home address! Only collect what's needed.
cues.text: The home address! Spelling practice doesn't need it. So should a helper grab as much information as it can, just in case? Nope! Only what the job needs.

cues.caption: Step 4: Present in about 1 minute
cues.text: Step four. Present your helper in about one minute. Short, and clear.

cues.caption: "Meet Tiffin Buddy!"
cues.text: Like this. Meet Tiffin Buddy! It helps class four kids pick a healthy snack. It learns from pictures of snacks. And it never stores anyone's face.

cues.caption: Speak slowly · Show a drawing · Smile
cues.text: Speak slowly. Show your drawing. And smile! Then take a bow.

cues.caption: Which plan is clearest AND safest?
cues.text: Detective time! Which plan is the clearest, and the safest? A, a helper. B, it does everything for everyone, and saves all data. C, Tiffin Buddy helps class four kids pick healthy snacks. It learns from snack pictures. It never stores faces. Or D, a helper that knows where all my friends live.

cues.caption: C! User, job, data, privacy rule
cues.text: C! It has a user, a job, data, and a privacy rule. Clear, and safe.

cues.caption: Your turn: capstone challenge
cues.text: Okay champ, here's your capstone challenge.

cues.caption: Name · who it helps · one thing not to store
cues.text: Name your helper. Say who it helps. And one thing it must not store. Pause the video, and try it on paper.

cues.caption: Plant Pal · my family · no photos of people
cues.text: Here's Meera's. Plant Pal helps my family water plants on time. It learns from leaf photos. It must never store photos of people. How did yours turn out? I bet it's amazing!

cues.caption: Helper = user + job + privacy rule
cues.text: Let's remember. A helper has a user, a job, and a privacy rule.

cues.caption: It learns patterns from data
cues.text: It learns patterns from examples. That's its data.

cues.caption: Collect only what the job needs
cues.text: Collect only what the job needs.

cues.caption: Present clearly in 1 minute
cues.text: And present it clearly, in one minute.

cues.caption: All 4 AI units: done!
cues.text: And champ, look how far you've come. What is AI. How machines learn. AI that sees, hears, and talks. And being smart and safe with AI.

cues.caption: AI track complete!
cues.text: You've finished the whole AI track! You can spot patterns, stay safe, and design your own AI helper. I'm so proud of you. You're an AI champ!

cues.caption: Next: Quiz · Tap Finish
cues.text: Tap Finish, and try your final quiz. Then go imagine your own amazing AI helper!
